instruction: Candid street photograph, full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor paved path lined with green trees, the man in the blue sweatshirt and black shorts (R1) walks forward on the left, smiling warmly at his partner. Beside him on the right, the blonde woman in the dark jacket and jeans (R2) walks forward, holding a coffee cup in one hand and carrying a beige tote bag on her shoulder while smiling. They walk side-by-side, holding hands. In the distant background, a few blurred pedestrians walk along the path under soft, natural daylight with cool tones.
